title: PR #52: fix(aurora): make model inference input UTF-8 safe
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Summary
- fix a real panic risk in Aurora ModelHub when prompts contain multi-byte UTF-8 text
- use Unicode scalar iteration for the preview instead of byte slicing
- add a regression test with non-ASCII input

## Audit finding
Aurora's Rust ModelHub used `&prompt[..40]`, which can panic when byte offset 40 is inside a UTF-8 code point. Aurora explicitly accepts natural-language input, so this is a concrete runtime correctness defect.

This PR deliberately fixes only the verified defect; it does not claim that the current ModelHub is a real LLM backend.
